versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Hacker News skill:

- Browse top, new, best, Ask HN, Show HN stories, and job postings.
- View item details, comments, and user profiles.
- Search stories and comments using Algolia.
- Find and view "Who is hiring?" threads.
- Supports CLI usage for all features with customizable limits and filters.
- Outputs clean, readable results with auto-converted text and relative timestamps.
